query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
---
name: ci-testing
on:
  push:
    # Temporarily run on every branch push, not only master, so the acceptance
    # tests exercise work-in-progress branches before a pull request exists.
    # Restore "branches: [master]" once branch runs are no longer needed.
    branches:
      - "**"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: test
        run: make test

  testacc:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        netbox-version:
          - v4.6.8
          - v4.6.9
          - v4.6.10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: testacc
        # Retry once on failure. Netbox itself is occasionally flaky at startup
        # or hits transient server-side bugs on a specific patch version; a
        # single retry (with a clean teardown in between) clears those without
        # masking real, reproducible failures.
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2; do
            echo "::group::testacc attempt $attempt (Netbox ${NETBOX_VERSION})"
            if make -e testacc; then exit 0; fi
            echo "::endgroup::"
            echo "::warning::testacc attempt $attempt failed on ${NETBOX_VERSION}; tearing down and retrying"
            make docker-down || true
          done
          exit 1
        env:
          NETBOX_VERSION: ${{ matrix.netbox-version }}
